Auth._comment: Descope project. Authority = 'https://api.descope.com/<PROJECT_ID>'. Audience = <PROJECT_ID>. Empty Authority = auth disabled (dev convenience before IdP provisioned).

Mongo._comment: MongoDB connection for new entities (profiles, decks, matches). Empty ConnectionString = endpoints return 503.

Cards._comment: Required. Base URL of the majik-cards private service. Startup throws if unset. Prod value lives in render.yaml; dev value in appsettings.Development.json.
